queueProfile.allocation: selected successful native allocations; memory pressure is not modeled

packetPolicy: All native NFLOG envelopes and AF_PACKET Ethernet reads are retained unchanged. Raw synthetic senders construct explicitly labeled inputs. PRE_DEFRAG raw IPv4 is authoritative for arrivals; delayed AF_PACKET aliases require exact whole-frame equality to actual same-episode egress bytes. No headers, checksums or Ethernet surfaces are manufactured for projection.
timing: Events use actual PRE NFLOG monotonic userspace read nanoseconds; ipfrag_time seconds scale by 1000000000. Every packet read is fenced by its actual raw/socket sender and assigned native post-step snapshot. Fixed timer deadlines and SNMP timeout deltas are checked with margin; internal jiffies and exact kernel execution times are not proved.
projection: The independent native checker supplies raw PRE/POST IPv4, unchanged observed Ethernet families, exact command/readback and trace joins, only actually observed native tables, explicit wait/erase events, and source-bound timeout emissions. Model output never constructs a native observation.
